A real demo: all four castle types and their stages were generated with AI (SDXL) in one consistent isometric style, cut out and assembled here live. In the game, each player picks one castle, and it evolves visually as they level up. Beside it stands that castle's Pass Guardian, which ranks up at level 1 (cub), 11 (adult) and 21 (crowned).
